summary: Verstappen hunts his fourth consecutive victory as McLaren's resurgent duo press their championship assault under the sweltering Sakhir lights. Norris and Piastri's strategic positioning—and how Red Bull counters their recent pace—will determine whether McLaren closes further on the drivers' standings. A dominant Verstappen performance cements his title credentials, while a McLaren double accelerates their constructors' championship claim in this punishing heat-hazard encounter.
